scope: Deterministic orchestration evidence and provenance receipt construction, validation, chaining and replay verification only. This packet does not dispatch providers, retry or reconcile providers, schedule workers, execute Book admission, mutate canonical manuscript state, persist records durably, publish artifacts, write Prose preferences, or perform fresh blind scoring.
laws: Every receipt is evidence-only. canonical_effect_allowed is always false and cannot be widened by any provider, evaluator, orchestrator or receipt consumer.
SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK remains the canonical manuscript owner; receipt emission never performs or substitutes for Book admission.
SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK/PROSE remains literary specialist authority with zero canonical manuscript-write authority.
Receipts bind to exact Book/project, workflow, workflow digest, source manuscript identity, plan and task identities when those identities are applicable.
Provider evidence binds to exact registered service/operation and provider subject identity; a SUCCESS result remains evidence and never becomes canonical admission.
Research evidence remains external evidence truth and never becomes Story Bible canon or manuscript canon merely because it appears in a receipt.
Author decisions are referenced, never synthesized, impersonated or inferred by the evidence emitter.
Raw manuscript, passage, candidate, private research or raw evaluator text is forbidden in orchestration receipts; use governed references and cryptographic hashes.
Receipt digests are deterministic over normalized receipt fields excluding receipt_digest.
Append-only receipt chains require monotonically increasing sequence numbers and exact parent receipt digests. Existing receipt bytes are never rewritten by this runtime.
Duplicate receipt IDs or duplicate receipt digests fail closed.
A receipt referring to a task must match that task's capability and authority domain from the exact execution plan.
A provider-task receipt must match the qualified Book Capability Routing descriptor and Service Registry V2 operation identity.
Retry-decision evidence may record the Phase-2F decision and operation identity but cannot execute a retry.
Failure evidence may record the Phase-2G disposition but cannot weaken fail-closed behavior.
Cancellation/resume evidence may record Phase-2H checkpoints and decisions but does not prove durable crash-survival persistence.
ADMISSION_HANDOFF_REFERENCE_OBSERVED records only a reference prepared for or returned by Book authority; it cannot set canonical manuscript state.
Replay verification reconstructs and validates receipt digests/chains from recorded references and identities; it does not replay provider side effects.
Fresh-context blind evaluation remains a separate authority boundary; this packet must not claim or manufacture blind isolation.
No hosted fixture grants A-01 target, native, private, publication or production authority.
privacy_rule: Receipts carry references/hashes and minimum identity metadata only. Raw manuscript/candidate/evaluator/research text is prohibited.
append_only_rule: appendReceipt accepts a previously validated chain and one new receipt, verifies exact next sequence and parent digest, and returns a new in-memory chain without altering prior receipt objects. Durable storage is Phase 5 work.
